The chain rule is the same as in the example: after a pair (A, B), the next pair in the chain is the one whose FIRST item is B. So, starting at wlv:

1. The pair (wlv, cgv) comes first. Its second item is cgv, so the next pair is the one whose first item is cgv: (cgv, ...).
2. The pair (cgv, ...) comes next. Its second item is ..., but ... never appears as a first item - so ... is the dangling end of the chain.

Therefore, the chain is: wlv, cgv, ...
